question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

All the players from this athletic club participated in the tournament and _______ one of them got a medal.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"each"** refers to every one of two or more people or things, considered separately. (प्रत्येक)

 
 
• **Example:** **Each** student was given a certificate for participation.
 
 
 
• **"Each"** implies that every individual member of a group is being referred to separately. (प्रत्येक)
 
 
• **Example:** **Each **of them received a gift.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **None** (कोई नहीं): Not any.

 
 
• **Example:** None of the answers were correct.
 
 
 
• **They** (वे): Used to refer to two or more people or things previously mentioned or easily identified.
 
 
• **Example:** They are going to the park.
 
 
 
• **All** (सभी): Used to refer to the whole quantity or extent of a particular group or thing.
 
 
• **Example:** All the students passed the exam.
